title: ProgrammaticEntity
description: One row = one programmatic page (e.g. /days-until/christmas/). This is the data contract between the SEO pipeline's 'Programmatic' tab and the site's dynamic route/layout component. Populate this from the pipeline output after human review, not automatically.

slug.description: URL segment, e.g. 'christmas'. Used to build /days-until/{slug}/

template.description: Which layout variant / URL pattern this entity belongs to

targetDate.description: Next occurrence, ISO 8601. Recompute yearly for recurring events (build job, not manual edit)

recurring.description: True for annual events like Christmas; false for one-off dates

status.description: Gates whether the route is statically generated / indexable. Only set to 'published' after the unique-content checklist below is satisfied.

uniqueContent.description: Fields that MUST be filled in per-entity to avoid thin/duplicate programmatic pages. If any required sub-field is empty, status cannot be 'published'.

blurb.description: 2-4 sentences unique to this entity — why this date/event matters, not template boilerplate

historicalNote.description: Optional: origin/history/trivia specific to this entity

relatedEntities.description: Slugs of related entities for internal linking (same category or SERP cluster)

generationPrompt.description: Prompt used with the image tool, kept for reproducibility

schema.description: Structured data to emit on the page
